newsitem.title: USA: Crown Cork buys aluminum producer from ACX Tech.
newsitem.headline: Crown Cork buys aluminum producer from ACX Tech.

text.p: Crown Cork & Seal Co. Inc. said Wednesday it has bought Golden Aluminum Co., which produces raw material for aluminum cans, from ACX Technologies Inc. for $70 million.
The price includes an immediate cash payment of $10 million and a deferred payment of $60 million due within two years.
Crown Cork, a Philadelphia-based supplier of packaging products to consumer marketing companies worldwide, has an option to resell Gold Aluminum to ACX during the next two years, it said.
ACX can retain a minority stake in Golden Aluminum ranging from 3.6 percent to 7.3 percent of the company's capital as of the deal's closing date, it said.
Crown Cork rose $1.50 to $54.25, while ACX edged up 25 cents to $19.125 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
